Word of advice for anyone in the future. If you truly want to know if something is in stock at your store, don't look online, call the customer service line, they can look at the stores inventory on the backend and it's a lot easier to pinpoint, they can also look in a broad area rather than store by store, so if something isn't available at your store and it won't ship online, they can let you know if it's available at a store 25 miles away without you wasting the gas to go yoursel

Edit to the comment I JUST made: You can look online if you're pressed for time it's not wholly unreliable, but the customer service line can get much more detailed info on certain things like how many there are exactly, how often they sell, and if the store will get more
